The Detroit Community-Academic Urban Research Center cohort


For several years, the[Michigan Health Endowment Fund](https://mihealthfund.org/) has supported nonprofit leaders to participate in[CHRT’s Health Policy Fellowship](https://chrt.org/fellowships/chrt-health-policy-fellowship/) . This support expands health policy capacity in the individuals it sponsers, strenghtening their ability to engage in policy discussions and advance evidence-based solutions that can make a different for their communities.


The Fund has also invested in efforts that support nonprofits at the organizational level, which they share in a new news feature that highlights the Health Policy Fellowship alongside the Fund’s partnership with the Detroit Community-Academic Urban Research Center over the last year.


CHRT is proud to be discussed alongside this important intiative. To learn more, read the whole story.
